observations: Photo 0 shows a single used automotive engine mount (bracket with rubber/hydraulic insulator block, metal bracket arms, and a center bolt).
A watermark reads 'ZITECH MOTORS GLOBAL' overlaid on the image, but this is a seller/business watermark, not a part brand or model stamped on the metal.
No visible manufacturer logo, part number, or OEM stamp on the mount itself.
Part shows some surface grime and wear consistent with a used/pulled unit; rubber insulator condition (cracks, tears, sagging) cannot be judged clearly from this angle alone.
Only one unit is shown despite the seller claiming availability 'for all Toyota and Lexus' models, implying multiple fitments not individually photographed.

claims.claim: Engine seats available for all Toyota and Lexus
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only one physical mount with no model-specific markings; fitment across 'all Toyota and Lexus' cannot be confirmed from a single image.

risks.risk: Exact vehicle model/engine fitment unknown — a mount that fits one Toyota/Lexus model will not fit most others.
risks.proof: A clear photo or video showing a stamped part number, or seller confirming exact make/model/engine code this specific unit was pulled from.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic/unverified-fitment used mount, not as a confirmed-fit part

risks.risk: Rubber/hydraulic insulator may be cracked, torn, or collapsed, which would make the mount non-functional.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rubber bushing from multiple angles, plus a photo/video showing no fluid leakage if hydraulic type.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / needing replacement insulator

risks.risk: Part could be aftermarket or a lower-quality reproduction rather than genuine OEM Toyota/Lexus.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of any casting marks, logos, or part number stamped into the metal bracket.

risks.risk: Mounting bolt holes or bracket arms could be bent, cracked, or previously welded from prior removal/accident damage.
risks.proof: Photos from at least two more angles showing the full bracket arms and bolt holes without obstruction.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unknown, assume cosmetic/structural defects

proof_requests: Photo or video of the stamped part number / OEM code on the mount.
Confirmation (in writing) of the exact Toyota or Lexus model, year, and engine this specific mount was removed from.
Close-up photos of the rubber/hydraulic insulator from front and side to check for cracks or leaks.
Additional angle photos showing the full bracket without the watermark obscuring detail.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used engine mount, but with no visible brand/model markings and no proof of fitment or rubber condition, it must be priced at worst case as a generic used mount of unverified fitment and unverified rubber integrity.
